description: Defines data structures, enums, and classes related to downlink PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) PDUs in 5G NR, including parameters, codewords, and maintenance info.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_maintenance_parameters_v3
classes.description: Contains parameters for maintaining DL PDSCH, including pattern configurations and rate matching info.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_parameters_v4
classes.description: Holds parameters for DL PDSCH configuration, including pattern bitmaps and MBSFN info.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_codeword
classes.description: Represents a codeword with target rate, modulation, MCS, and size.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_pdu
classes.description: Main structure representing a downlink PDSCH PDU with all associated parameters, including codewords, resource allocation, and power profiles.
